import sys, os, time, hashlib
REC = sys.argv[1]
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
ROOT = Path('/root/worktrees/send-c1b'); sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/'backend'))
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r8 import CAPTIONS
rc = R24.rc
r26 = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(r26.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('5683ff7b')
SRC = dict(r26=r26, r27=open(_p.__file__).read())
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('rev27e_'+n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = dict((n, mk(n)) for n in SRC)
forbid = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http')); calls = Counter()
def run(pages, people, allowed):
    pdf = rc.pages_pdf(pages); out = []
    for n, m in M.items():
        mo = Mock(); r = in_process(m, pdf, people, mo); calls[n] += mo.call_count
        out.append('W' if rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed) else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n'))
    return ''.join(out)
X = 72; G = Counter(); t = time.time()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', forbid):
    for recital, head, cap, aff, acap, signer, fleet in product((REC,),
            ('RECIPIENT:', None, 'HL ANALYTICS, INC.', 'harbor light analytics, inc.', 'For and on behalf of the Recipient', 'THE SUPPLIER'),
            CAPTIONS + ['By:'], ('HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.'), (None, 'GUARANTOR:'),
            ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'), ('l2', 'single')):
        rows = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X)]
        rows += [(310, 'By:', True, X)] if fleet == 'l2' else [(300, 'Date:', True, X)]
        if head: rows.append((340, head, False, X))
        rows += [(370, cap, True, X), (382, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, X), (420, 'Date:', True, X)]
        if acap: rows.append((490, acap, False, X))
        rows += [(520, aff, False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X), (600, 'Date:', True, X)]
        pages = [list(rc.RECITALS[recital]), rows]
        pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
        people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
        key = run(pages, people, {rc.PE: (2, 0, 370, 612), rc.DE: (2, 0, 270, 612)})
        kind = 'affiliate' if aff.startswith('HARBOR LIGHT GROUP') else 'own_company(L-2)'
        G[(kind, key, fleet if 'W' in key else '')] += 1
print(REC, 'http', forbid.call_count, 'calls', sorted(calls.items()), 'elapsed', round(time.time() - t))
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
